notes.title: Patch 3.4.2.2
notes.content: [p]Another small update but it's a feature I liked so much that I just had to include it in the demo. I built this crosshair UI that makes a lot of important information like dash stamina, grapple stamina, ammo, weapon heat and charging, summon availability and count and powerup duration all accessible through the crosshair.[/p][p]It'll probably take a bit of experimentation to see what signifies what, but I think the animations help to bring your attention to these things as you use them.[/p][p]I probably don't want to add too much more to this for now to prevent it getting more cluttered, but it's very nice for being able to play with a minimal UI setup that is still useful.[/p][p]I've enjoyed this immensely, I'm finding myself playing a lot more obsessively than I usually do because of how the balance of information and priorities is playing out now.[/p][p]Get hype for the release! I can't be specific about dates just yet, but it is definitely coming along well.[/p][p][/p][p]You can change UI modes with Tab (default) to try out more or less minimal UI setups. Enjoy![/p][p]Love,[/p][p]V0ID[/p]

notes.title: Patch 3.4.2
notes.content:
Hello abyss-dwellers,

Just dropping another wee patch in preparation for Bigger Things™

Things to check out:

[list]
[*]Improved tutorial / pregame for beginners that shows you basic mechanics and where to start

[*]Improvements on weapon animations and ragdolls
[*]Brought back the skull tendrils in the background from previous builds and some other improvements to the environment
[*]Fixed an issue of Necromancers not playing their summoning animations, making their summoning and the unit summoned rather disjointed
[/list]

Enjoy!

Much love, have a sick weekend.
-V0ID

notes.title: Demo version 3.4
notes.content:
Hello friends.

We're now up to version 3.4 of the playable demo of Necromancer.

We're on the last stretch of development before the game can be fully released!

More news on that soon, but in the meantime here's a general description of the changelog (many more changes than what's listed here, but it'll give you a good idea).

[h1]Changelog - [/h1]

• Improved level design, lighting, general aesthetic
• Added a console for debugging and testing
• Added a session log file to track logs, located in game save folder
• Improved overall balance, physics, movement, etc.
• Added health bars for summons
• Added blood and gore particle effects and ragdolls for unit deaths
• Added options for control of post-processing effects
• Improved main menu visuals and added a character design for the player character, LXXIV IRON EATER
• Improved music with better composition and mixing for all tracks (Main Menu, Arena, Codex)
• Added a timeout so the game returns to the main menu after some inactivity
• Improved visuals for all units
• Unit composition reworked. 
[list]
    [*]Revenants no longer spawn on their own, they can only be spawned by Necromancers.
    [*]Two types of enemy necromancers can be spawned by the level, "Terror" and "Elite" Necromancers.
    [*]Bulleted list
[*] Each necromancer will first spawn a Revenant or Elite Revenant, and if left alive too long will spawn a "Terror" or "Elite terror".
[*] Liches no longer spawn "Lacerator" enemies, these are now instead spawned by Dreadnoughts.
[*] Added mines to Dreadnoughts to assist with late-game pressure balance.
[*] Improved visuals and telegraphing for Lich "shotgun" attack
[*] Removed Lich "wandering pillar" attack, replaced with tornados which spawn lightning attacks
[/list]
• + many other changes and QOL improvements.

We'll also likely drop another small patch soon to cover some small fixes but in the meantime, enjoy some ANNIHILATION.

Love,
V0ID

notes.title: Version 3.2 - The Big Arena
notes.content:
I originally planned for this to come out around christmas 2022 (lmao). I've been working on it like a maniac but I kept finding things that needed improvement.

In any case, here it is! Demo version 3.2 features a whole bunch of changes, most notably an expanded arena, a brand new grappling hook to help with mobility and improve the movement feel, a far more simplified upgrade system and an overall massive boost in gameplay speed. There's a lot more to it, so have a look below for a more detailed changelog.

If you have comments or feedback, please head on over to[u][b][url= https://discord.gg/BQUrRZX] https://discord.gg/BQUrRZX[/url][/b][/u] where there's a channel dedicated to feedback. And also just memes, dankness and general sh*tposting. 

[b][u]Major changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Removed health system and replaced it with resurrection system (extra life, get a temporary buff when you die)
[*] If you don't have a resurrection token you die in one hit. Resurrection tokens are one of the power ups.
[*] Power ups (annihilation, resurrection) no longer spawn in the blood altar/shrine, these spawn in the middle instead
[*] All shrines are now active and allow you to purchase upgrades from them. The variant system has been reworked so that the variation is now less based on RNG, but you now have upgrade "tiers" that all net variations of the same upgrade type. However, variation costs are slightly randomised every run.
[*] You no longer have to press a button to bank for upgrades, simple walk over to them and pick them up as they become affordable / available.
[*] Added a grappling hook. This has quite a long range, but its cooldown is variable based on the distance travelled. (close range distance CD is ~3s, long range is ~8s)
[*] Arena expanded to multiple platforms for use with grappling hook
[*] Improved general game speed, especially projectiles and enemy movement speeds
[*] Removed tutorial mode and replaced this with a small pre-game tutorial
[*] Summons no longer cost souls or are able to be summoned simultaneously, and are instead summoned out of resurrectable souls that periodically drop from certain enemy kills
[*] Leaderboard cleared
[*] Some spawnset changes 
[*] Several weapons (snubnose dual-wields, railguns, reaver) now use raycasting (laser check) instead of projectiles, so projectile speeds are instant for these

[/list]

[b][u]QOL and aesthetic changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved casting animation speed and responsivity (for summoning)
[*] Added an automatic swap-out after 2 clicks of trying to fire an empty weapon (no ammo)
[*] Improved particles and shaders in main menu
[*] Added some parameters to options to start with gauntlets / skip tutorial if you have found gauntlets already, or have completed the tutorial
[*] Made in-game UI towers face player at all times. Shrines have progress bars and greyed holograms to show availability or progress to availability
[*] Added large (main) UI tower in the middle
[*] Added a "Sh*tposter" tower that floats around giving words of "encouragement"
[*] Some sound changes, including hit confirm / armour hit fail, some terrain hit sounds
[*] Added sounds for confirming spells coming off cooldown
[*] In-game UI simplified, some scaling improvements for 32:10 - 5:4 aspect ratio ranges
[*] Improved animations for player deaths
[*] Some changes to enemy colouring and materials
[*] Some changes to loading screen
[*] Some minor lighting changes
[/list]

[b][u]Balance changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Shotgun also does raycasting, has larger radius
[*] Shotgun and Snubnose type raycasters do damage based on distance
[*] Sledgehammer rate of fire massively increased and clip size increased, damage decreased
[*] Judgement charge rate decreased
[*] Goregun spread pattern is now a charged wave of explosions
[*] Gauntlet range reduced
[*] Hand cannon and Snubnose rate of fire decreased
[*] Friendly revenant health decreased
[*] Changes to terror enemies, including visuals, speed, spread pattern
[*] Several enemies now have improved projectile speeds, movespeeds and higher health pools
[/list]

Honestly there's a lot more changes than that in all sorts of miscellaneous nooks and crannies but that's about the most noteworthy stuff.

In any case, hope you enjoy it, it's been a blast to develop and I've had a lot of fun in testing as well.

More soon!
Love,
V0ID

I completely spaced so the date itself already passed something like a week ago, but it still warrants celebration. Better late than never!

V 3.1.1

Changelog

[list]
[*] +

notes.title: Version 3 is here!
notes.content:
[b]TL:DR; New update, new leaderboard, new trailer, unit animations, total rebuild, improvements to visual clarity and performance. Launchpads removed to make way for a teleport mechanic.[/b]

Well it's been a total clusterf*** of a year, rife with a bunch of craziness.

After realising that an update to the newest version of Unity ended up decreasing performance [i]significantly[/i] (absolute garbage FPS), along with realising how many things were just messy and not how I wanted the game to be looking and functioning, it turned out the best solution to it was just rebuilding the Unity project from the ground up.

It wasn't a complete do-over; at least I had all the old scripts, models, and audio assets, but the project scenes needed to be completely built again. I also went through the models for all the environment and units, doing cleanup operations to dramatically reduce the vertex counts (the average vertex count in V2 was over 1 million (usually more) and now it's closer to 3-400,000. I did a bunch of debugging and looking at performance sinks, and reduced unnecessary graphics draw calls and inefficient object find operations. (Always fun looking at your n00b work from way back and having to rework that stuff)

Having now done that, and though it took a good month of backtracked progress, I can now say it's fully been worth it. The game is now looking and playing much better than it used to, and a lot closer to being something I can be just genuinely proud of. There were a lot of delays, such as life stuff, a covid lockdown, work stuff, my computer just deciding it wanted to end itself and needing a replacement CPU and Motherboard, and other miscellaneous shenanigans. Regardless, I've been able to keep myself sane (comparatively) with this project and it's been a blast making it better than it was before.

[u]Anyway, on to the updates![/u]

[list]
[*] [b]New leaderboard![/b] Since the mechanics have changed a bit by now, I figure it's time for there to be a refreshed leaderboard so people can compete with the new mechanics.
[*] The store page now has an [b]updated trailer[/b]! Please do share it around if you're so inclined, it'd help a lot!
[*]Most important enemies now have actual [b]animations[/b]! This should help with making them a bit more dynamic rather than just floating statues. Revenants (basic enemies) also have a melee bomb attack to discourage letting armies of them get too close to you. (More melee attacks and enemy dynamics to come in later updates)
[*]Numerous other [b]stat tweaks[/b].
[*]Complete [b]visual overhaul[/b], not only for performance purposes but also for visual clarity (visual clarity being a big focus of the rebuild, as this was a common complaint for a lot of people)
[*][b]Launchpads removed[/b] (at least for now) as this tended to increase issues in visual clarity and also ended up making for pretty cheesy gameplay as it allowed for very easy dodging tricky situations, and get people into loops of just running for launchpads constantly. This has been [b]replaced with a teleport mechanic[/b] [i](acquired from the spirit altar)[/i], which allows you to instantly relocate to another location/altar, but has a 40ish second cooldown. [i](I'd recommend redoing the tutorial to familiarise yourself with this.)[/i]
[/list]

There's still a long way to go before I can call this project done, but hopefully not too much longer before I can do something like a proper early access of the full game. If there's bugs, please do let me know!

Thank you everyone for your support so far, I couldn't have gotten to this point without the people cheering me on to keep this going and not just lose heart. 

Merry Christmas, Happy holidays, and much love,
V0ID

(I'd recommend redoing the tutorial to familiarise yourself with this.)

notes.title: Demo version 6
notes.content:
Hey friends,

We're now up to version 6 of the demo.

We're getting close to the planned release time. I'm still not 100% sure about the exact release date, so hold tight while I finalise that. 

In the meantime, this version of the demo will change up the mechanics slightly, for the purposes of the mechanics being more clear for newer players as well as allowing for a bit more build control and flexibility.

The main change is, [b]spells can now be cast whenever they can be afforded, rather than needing other prerequisites. [/b] Spells used to be cast in the priority of > Heal if under max health, summon if under max summons, bank if at max summons and max health, and were all handled by one keybind.

[b]Now, Heals and summons each have their own keybind, and banking souls is split between two keys, allowing you to bank at either the Spirit altar or the Weapon altar.[/b] This makes for more control, but actually makes the game a bit more challenging as there's now a bit more decision making involved. 

[b][u]Please check your keybinds, as some keys may now conflict with the new default keybinds![/u][/b]

Other changes are:

[list]
[*]More UI elements to show if heals or summons are available
[*]UI now shows weapon selected
[*]Weapons now have a camera shake effect
[*]bunnyhopping now adds a movement boost up to a point, so momentum can be gained for more airtime. Walking reduces this momentum.
[*] Launchpads are less restrictive now, but have an energy level that depletes with repeated use, and recharges over time.
[*]Dashing mid-launchpad boost resets momentum, allowing you more control over your landing location.
[*]Some sound additions
[*]You can no longer jump infinitely on walls; you get one spare jump on a wall before needing to wait for a cooldown to be timed out.
[/list]

[u]Changelog[/u]

[list]
[*]Menu improvements
[*]Fixed issues with UI enabled toggle in menu meaning toggle in-game is unavailable
[*]Improved volume sliders

[*]Various model, texture, material, and general visual changes

[*]Added dash
[*]Added new summon (Juggernaut), and key binding to switch between summons
[*]Added helixes to various enemies for better visibility
[*]Reworked juggernaut motion. Juggernauts no longer charge at you (this is now done by smaller "Terror" enemies that swarm you) but instead lob damaging explosive barrages.
[*]Removed and redid tutorial system for tips, including lore system that gives more information over time. Tutorials, tips and lore now show in pre-game "loading" screen.
[*]Added several "UI towers" to help see more in-game information, including powerup duration, and inventory

[*]Moved placement of some of the spawn points to be easier to see enemies coming out of
[*]Changed shoot rate for weapons such as shotgun and crucifier, improved projectile speed for Bonebag
[*]Reworked projectiles for Reaver for much better performance
[*]Several other performance improvements in code, graphics, and enemy behaviour
[*]Made some adjustments to graphics quality settings for performance
[*]Several animation improvements such as "dissolve" effect on deaths, improvements to soul spending animations / casting animations
[*]Improved death screen and personal best notification
[/list]
